# 74273 - Octal D-type flip-flop with clear

Package DIP-20 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74273.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74273.json)

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | CLR | input | low |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 2, 5, 6, 9, 12, 15, 16, 19 |
| 2 | 1Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 3 | 1D | input |  |  |  |
| 4 | 2D | input |  |  |  |
| 5 | 2Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 6 | 3Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 7 | 3D | input |  |  |  |
| 8 | 4D | input |  |  |  |
| 9 | 4Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 10 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 11 | CLK | clock |  |  | rising edge |
| 12 | 5Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 13 | 5D | input |  |  |  |
| 14 | 6D | input |  |  |  |
| 15 | 6Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 16 | 7Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 17 | 7D | input |  |  |  |
| 18 | 8D | input |  |  |  |
| 19 | 8Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 20 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 1Q = FF1 | Shows flip-flop 1. |
| 5 | 2Q = FF2 | Shows flip-flop 2. |
| 6 | 3Q = FF3 | Shows flip-flop 3. |
| 9 | 4Q = FF4 | Shows flip-flop 4. |
| 12 | 5Q = FF5 | Shows flip-flop 5. |
| 15 | 6Q = FF6 | Shows flip-flop 6. |
| 16 | 7Q = FF7 | Shows flip-flop 7. |
| 19 | 8Q = FF8 | Shows flip-flop 8. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 8

Changes on: rising edge of CLK

- CLR low: all eight flip-flops = 0 at once
- CLR high, rising CLK: flip-flop = D
- CLR high, CLK low (no edge): hold

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | SN74273 figures (page 3). SN74LS273: IOL 8 mA, IOH -0.4 mA (page 4). |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CLR | any Q | PHL | 18 | 27 |
| CLK | any Q | PLH | 17 | 27 |
| CLK | any Q | PHL | 18 | 27 |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns | Min MHz | Typ MHz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| clock frequency | CLK |  |  | 30 | 40 |
| pulse width | CLK or CLR |  | 16.5 |  |  |
| setup | D | CLK | 20 |  |  |
| setup | CLR inactive state | CLK | 25 |  |  |
| hold | D | CLK | 5 |  |  |

## Notes

SN74273 figures. SN74LS273 (pages 4-5, RL 2 kohm, CL 15 pF): the same delays (18/27, 17/27, 18/27 ns typ/max) and fmax 30/40 MHz; pulse width 20 ns, setup 20 ns, clear setup 25 ns, hold 5 ns. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS273.

- [TI SN54273/SN54LS273/SN74273/SN74LS273 datasheet SDLS090 (October 1976, revised March 1988)](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74ls273.pdf) - 1, 2, 3, 4, 5; SN74273
